result:
Survey is at `library/domains/engineering/domains/tech/domains/computing/texts/continuous-learning-in-agentic-harnesses.md`.

**What it covers (6 systems):**

| System | Type | Key mechanism |
|--------|------|---------------|
| **ECC** | Production harness | Deterministic hook observation -> background Haiku observer -> instincts with confidence scoring -> evolution into skills/commands/hooks. Quality gate via checklist + holistic verdict. |
| **OpenClaw** | Production harness | Six integrated mechanisms: file-based memory, autonomous skill creation, heartbeat monitoring, hook-driven learning, SOUL.md boundaries, DM Policy input gating. |
| **Cline** | Production harness | Manual Memory Bank (5 markdown files) + `.clinerules`. No automatic learning — fully auditable but fully human-driven. |
| **Voyager** | Research (Minecraft) | Executable skill library indexed by semantic embeddings. Compositional — skills build on earlier skills. Multi-signal verification. |
| **Reflexion** | Research | Verbal self-reflection converts reward signals to episodic memory buffer prepended to context. 91% HumanEval. |
| **LATS** | Research | Monte Carlo Tree Search with multi-point self-critique. Trajectories as learned artifacts. 92.7% HumanEval. |

**Key findings:**

1. Three elements are necessary: structured observation capture, persistent indexing, and quality validation before reuse
2. Confidence decay (ECC/561) prevents stale patterns — most systems lack this
3. Scope isolation with promotion (ECC/OpenClaw/561) prevents cross-project contamination

**561-specific notes:** Our settlement path framing (inquiry -> derivation -> procedure -> process), failure-driven learning pipeline, and typed officer duties give us tighter feedback loops than any surveyed system. Patterns worth evaluating: autonomous skill creation (OpenClaw), semantic embedding retrieval (Voyager), heartbeat monitoring (OpenClaw).
